content.short: Tangible maintains purchasing power with the first stablecoin backed by tokenized, yield-generating real estate.
content.description: Tangible is an ecosystem for tokenized real world assets. Real USD, a native yield-generating stablecoin backed by real estate, powers the marketplace and enables access to tokenized and fractionalized RWAs. The platform links Real USD to tangible assets by tokenizing ownership and enabling fractional participation in asset classes that were previously capital intensive. Through Tangible, anyone can use Real USD to purchase valuable physical goods from the world’s leading suppliers via the marketplace.
